description.en: The unique identifier of the authentication request.

title.zh: 凭证识别结果查询（异步）

descriptions.zh: 当您获取到TransactionId之后，可以在服务端通过该接口获取相应的认证结果。
descriptions.en: After you obtain the TransactionId, you can call this operation on the server side to retrieve the corresponding authentication result.
